scopeOfLaterChanges: After initialCorrection, Sources.page and DJs.page remain byte-identical. fixture.input: Native CUA only,1280x720 normal app zoom; passive Playwright launch/observation.
fixture.storage: Copied instrumented actual main/storage, disposable safeStorage/catalog, null shared-key adapter, stopped scheduler and muted media.
fixture.faults: Post-guard saveNewsSources/saveDjs hold or injected pre-operation rejection. Not actual OS disk failure.
fixture.processes: All four observers exit0. Exact owned catalog PID28194 stopped with exit143; later exact PID28826 stopped with exit143.
fixture.screenshots: Source failure and three DJ failure stages inspected inline; PNGs not retained. Initial DJ failure clips the action; nearest reveals button but leaves outline against clipping edge; final inset reveal shows whole outline with space below.
fixture.nativeAXLimitation: AX sometimes retains selected input text after focus moved; read-only DOM activeElement, outline and geometry establish actual action focus. Native text entry appended Focus host to preset name in nearestReveal; actual saved name is retained in snapshots, not normalized by assertion.

limitations: No new independent paired review, unit tests, AT/VoiceOver, listener, audible, live-provider/server, actual OS failure, platform matrix, release or deferred resolution/zoom acceptance.
Source runtime covers RSS create/delete; Twitter/Hacker News branches and DJ Simple/Advanced saves are source-reviewed only in this change.
Existing affected-profile warning semantics are unchanged; native fixtures do not newly establish linked-profile deletion warnings.
No new hidden-window, nested overlay or page-navigation error-retention proof.
